{"model": "gpt-6.1-sol", "instructions": "Write a summary of at most 600 characters for NOC staff in summary, in plain sentences, using only the supplied parts. Answer only with the JSON object.", "input": "### Title (Incident record)
Subscriber DB server: Disk full — 3 services affected

### Investigation (Incident record)
Likely cause: Rapid transaction-log archive accumulation, most likely from a catch-up run, exhausted /data on the Subscriber DB server (srv-db-01 / lab-db-01). The archive occupies 8.5 GiB, with 8.5 GiB written under /data in 15 minutes. Only 0.1 GiB remains free, below the database's 256 MiB write-refusal threshold, explaining the database write errors and downstream API errors, USSD failures and SMS queue growth.
Uncertainty: A catch-up run is strongly suggested but not verified. The diagnostics do not identify the recently written files as transaction-log archives or establish whether backup shipping or the nightly purge failed.

### Alerts (Alert data)
126 alerts of 7 types: balance_api_errors, bundle_api_errors, db_write_errors, disk_full, sms_queue_growth, ussd_synthetic_failed, ussd_timeouts

### Customer impact (Service context)
Balance Check (USSD) (svc-balance-check), criticality critical, through api-balance, db-subscriber, ussd-gw
Bundle Purchase (svc-bundle-purchase), criticality critical, through api-bundle, db-subscriber, ussd-gw
SMS Notifications (svc-sms-notifications), criticality high, through sms-queue

### Hypothesis (Service context)
Subscriber DB server (srv-db-01), kind server, criticality critical; 6 other affected components depend on it

### E1 (Diagnostic output)
/data is 100% full (15.9 of 15.9 GiB used, 0.1 GiB free)

### E2 (Diagnostic output)
Largest folder under /data: /data/txlog_archive (8.5 GiB)

### E3 (Diagnostic output)
8.5 GiB written to 34 files under /data in the last 15 minutes", "max_output_tokens": 600, "text": {"format": {"type": "json_schema", "name": "sl_t_2", "schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"summary": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["summary"], "additionalProperties": false}, "strict": true}}}
